label: Depositor protection limit
unit: KRW per person, per financial institution
appliesTo: Anyone holding protected deposits at a Korean financial institution, foreign nationals included
why: The cap applies per institution, not per account, and protected deposits within one institution are added together to test it — so it decides how many banks a large balance should be spread across. It doubled in 2025 after standing unchanged for years, which is exactly the kind of move an English-language guide keeps quoting the old figure for.

history.note: The limit in force until the increase.
Doubled. Principal plus stipulated interest, per person per institution.
